text: {"lessons":["I sold several winners for gains, then later realized a very large loss on Stock C; I should let a consistent plan—not the urge to secure a gain or avoid regret—guide each sale.","My average cost is not a reason to keep a losing stock or buy more; I should reassess its prospects and set risk limits based on what I know now.","After account value fell, I sold some positions at losses and bought Stock B and D; I should avoid reactive trades and check that each change fits my overall portfolio plan."]}
